description: NPV of periodic cash flows (t = 0, 1, 2, ...; the t = 0 flow is not discounted) at a per-period discount rate given as a decimal. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.npv@1, every step, and any warnings.

cash_flows.description: Periodic cash flows at t = 0, 1, 2, …; negative for outflows (e.g. purchase price at t = 0). At most 10000.

rate.description: Discount rate per period as a decimal, e.g. 0.08 for 8%. Match the cash-flow period: for monthly flows pass the monthly rate (e.g. 0.06 ÷ 12 = 0.005). Must be greater than -1.

name: calc_npv
title: Net present value
